description: A small, deterministic, offline test fixture for the hot-five-porto collector. shows-excerpt.html is NOT a live fetch — it is a trimmed excerpt containing 6 of the 52 real event cards from the retained investigation evidence at research/source-investigations/hot-five-porto-01/evidence/body-shows.html (itself a plain curl GET of https://hotfive.pt/shows/ acquired 2026-08-25T01:31:00Z per that investigation's evidence[] entry "ev-shows-body"). Every card block was copied byte-for-byte (including original whitespace) from that retained file; nothing in this fixture was invented.

cards_included.title: All About... Blues
cards_included.notes: normal single-button card with a lebillet.eu ticket href

not_included: 46 of the 52 real /shows/ cards were omitted only to keep this fixture small and bounded, per docs/SOURCE_INVESTIGATION_POLICY.md's bounded-evidence principle -- omission does not imply anything about those cards' content.
